osmnxr: OpenStreetMap street networks for R

Source: R/osmnxr-package.R
osmnxr-package.Rd

A tidyverse-friendly toolkit to download, model, simplify, analyze and visualize street networks and other geospatial features from OpenStreetMap. The design follows Geoff Boeing's OSMnx Python library: the public API mirrors its function names (graph_from_place becomes ox_graph_from_place()), and its modelling choices (network types, the Overpass filters, topology simplification, intersection consolidation, the urban metrics) are reproduced. The code is a reimplementation: no Python runtime is involved, and the graph algorithms run in the bundled Rust crate osmnxr-core (https://strategicprojects.github.io/osmnxr-core/).

References

Boeing, G. (2025). Modeling and analyzing urban networks and amenities with OSMnx. Geographical Analysis, 57(4), 567–577. doi:10.1111/gean.70009

See also

OSMnx: https://osmnx.readthedocs.io/. The package website: https://strategicprojects.github.io/osmnxr/.
